meta.name: project-retrospective
meta.description: Use when a project needs multi-session retrospective analysis: after milestones, before starting a new phase, when vision drift is suspected, or every 3-5 sessions. Triggers include user saying retro, run a retro, since-last-retro; asks to analyze patterns, recurring mistakes, or correction trends across multiple sessions; says how did we get here or project history in a project-arc context (not single-file diffs or README edits); or notes that MEMORY.md has drifted from what actually happened across sessions. NOT for single-session review, MEMORY.md cleanup, retro templates, or git-level file diffs.

copy.tagline: 回顾多轮项目历程，发现模式与改进点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目进行多轮后需要系统性地回顾和优化
